mike: Quick follow-up from PM: postmortem items -> runbook edits + short mitigation playbook. Need owners and quick deadlines.

tara: I'll add a 'gpu/cache triage' subsection with 3 copy-paste checks:
- nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,memory.used --format=csv
- ps aux | grep redwood-runtime
- ./internal/kv_stats --pool=pool-x
I'll put expected outputs (e.g., memory.used > 90% -> OOM risk).

joel: I'll author a reversible mini-playbook: reduce batch, route 20% to fallback, graceful shard restart. CLI examples included.

mike: ACTIONS:
- ACTION: tara -> add triage checks + expected outputs to incidents/playbooks/gpu_cache.md. Due: 48h.
- ACTION: joel -> draft mini-playbook with rollback notes and sample commands. Due: 72h.
- ACTION: mike -> create PR template for runbook edits requiring owner, test steps, and link to postmortem. Due: 48h.

ops-bot: Canary note: last canary to pool-x at 1930000000; canary flag: off.

tara: recommend a short canary gate: 10-15m synthetic run, p95 check, KV-growth check. Add canary.yml example to PR.

joel: I'll also scan recent incidents for eviction+batch correlations and attach a short summary to the postmortem doc. If we see a threshold, propose auto-route rule.

mike: Schedule a 30m dry-run with next oncall (Wed 09:30 PT). Post PR links here when ready so we can walk through. :thumbsup:
